'''Orryxian Catsblood''' was a popular<ref name="TruAtBak" /> type of [[Alcohol/Legends|intoxicating]] beverage<ref name="GG9" /> from the [[Orryxia system/Legends|Orryxia system]]<ref name="TruAtBak" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> It shared its name<ref name="GG9" /> with the [[Orryxian]]s, a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|425|Orryxian}}</ref> from the selfsame [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Orryxian]]|system=Orryxia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> Orryxian Catsblood was not as well-known as some other beverages in the Outer Rim, but could be obtained by especially dedicated drinkers.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orryxian Catsblood was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] and published in [[1993]].<ref name="GG9" />
